title: Deako Switch Event Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Zigbee2MQTT device reports (`zigbee2mqtt:device`), Shelly/Tasmota telemetry (`shelly:status`, `tasmota:sensor`), Hue bridge events (`hue:event`), Nest/Ecobee thermostat (`ecobee:thermostat`), door/leak/motion sensors.
app: Philips Hue, smart plugs (Tasmota/Shelly/TP-Link Kasa), thermostats (Nest/Ecobee), locks, and Zigbee/Z-Wave sensors via MQTT / Zigbee2MQTT and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=deako:switch
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(circuit_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Deako switch event events land each day and how many distinct circuit values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Deako switch event records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct circuit values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It will count how much Deako switch event activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
